title: Beverage filter cartridge
abstract: A beverage filter cartridge comprises an impermeable pierceable base with a self-supporting wettable filter element that is smaller than the base, creating two sealed chambers. The filter element diverges from the base, forming a first chamber for storing beverage extract and a second enlarged chamber for beverage outflow. An impermeable pierceable cover seals the cartridge, enabling dual penetration for water inlet and beverage outlet without damaging the filter.
gist: The K-Cup: a sealed single-serve coffee cartridge with a self-supporting conical filter inside. The brewer pierces the top for hot water and the bottom for outflow, brewing one fresh cup with zero cleanup — the patent that built Keurig's razor-and-blades empire.
